bands.source: pKd >= 7 (Kd <= 100 nM) is the standard binder cut-off used to binarise Davis in the DTA literature. The moderate line at pKd 6 (1 uM) is our own, following normal pharmacology practice.
bands.floor_note: Davis records non-binding as exactly 5.0, so about 70% of its labels sit at the bottom of the scale.

confidence_calibration.note: Tertiles of the MC-dropout spread on the validation set. A relative label only - this is not a confidence interval.

scope_thresholds.basis: 10th percentile of each training entry's similarity to its nearest other training entry. Compounds: Tanimoto on Morgan r2 2048-bit fingerprints. Proteins: Jaccard overlap of 3-mers.

davis.why: Phase 5 Step B, 400 epochs, two seeds averaged

bands.source: No binarisation threshold is standard for Metz. We apply the same pharmacology convention as Davis: pKi 7 = 100 nM, pKi 6 = 1 uM. This is our assumption, not a published cut-off.

bands.source: KIBA score >= 12.1 is the standard binder cut-off in the DTA literature (the transformed equivalent of the original KIBA <= 3.0). The moderate line at 11.1 is the lower edge of the crowded band identified in the Perceiver CPI paper, and is our own choice.
